_comment: tier = release status: launch | next | planned | dev | no (dev = maintainer test device for bringing up a line; never published or offered by the installer). security = docs/DEVICE-TIERS.md: gold | silver | bronze | none. line = gold (GrapheneOS downstream, build/*.sh) or aosp (PD-SVAK AOSP line, 2027). Pixel support-end dates from grapheneos.org/faq (2026-11-14); others are the vendor's update promise. Non-Pixel codenames, dates and relock status are UNVERIFIED until tested on real hardware.

devices.name: Fairphone 5
devices.limits: Relocks with a custom AVB key, but no MTE and a weaker secure element than Pixel: less protection against forensic extraction
